## Summary

Install a high steer kit on the front axle to allow for flat draglink operation. [t1237]

## Parts

- [Partial] DIY crossover steering kit from Complete Offroad [t1237]

## Specifications

## Tips & gotchas

- Ream out the stock pitman arm taper or use a tapered sleeve if using TRE components. [t1237]
- Run the tie rod over the knuckle rather than under it for better angles. [t1237]
